svg.text: A parent's horns, ears, crest, antennae or tail live in its own pixel rows, so a baby that takes those rows carries them, in any tier (about 1 in 2).
New shapes still grow only on Mutant and Prismatic hatches (the ledger decides the tier).
Soso · Mask × Hoverer · F1 · Horns, Stripes · walk down
Fove · Cellular × Skeleton · F1 · Crest, Tail, Rainbow · walk right
Kave · Hollow × Family · F1 · Crest, Stripes · walk down
Lami · Sparkling × Asymmetry · F1 · Crest, Rainbow · walk right
Their babies carry the shape, even as Commons
The walk strip shows the Common baby; its traits name the parent the shape came from.
Divo · Cellular × Hoverer · F2 · Crest (from Fove) · walk down
Furu · Family × Sparkling · F2 · Crest (from Kave) · walk right
Lupi · Sparkling × Skeleton · F2 · Crest (from Lami) · walk down
Soso's shape passes to Mome (F2), then on to an F3; each step is its own 1 in 2.
Soso · Mask × Hoverer · F1 · Horns, Stripes · walk right
Mome · Hoverer × Colossus · F2 · Horns (from Soso), Side-walker · walk right
Kote · Cellular × Hoverer · F3 · Horns (from Mome), Side-walker · walk right
